k: Head of the network that airs Eddie's show
st: Jack warns Eddie to go easy on Carlton Drake, then fires him for accusing Drake on camera without a source.

files.notes: Named once in dialogue ('This guy, he is all the way bad, Jack'); the other 'Jack' lines in the transcript belong to the bartender. The network's name (MNBN) is wiki text only and is never said; the app already files Eddie's employer as The Brock Report, the show Jack's network airs and that he assigns, so he is keyed to it. If the owner prefers, Independent.

st: Richard, a guard at Eddie's building, celebrates his daughter's scholarship to MIT with Eddie.
He bars a fired Eddie from going upstairs, and Eddie stops Venom from eating him.

files.notes: Greeted by name twice (transcript). He guards the network building, but the network is never named on screen and he is not part of Eddie's show, so Independent.

k: A detective believed dead, now a symbiote host
st: As a young officer, Mulligan shoots Frances in the eye and believes he has killed her.
Now a detective, he brings Eddie to Kasady, then arrests and grills Eddie after Kasady escapes as Carnage.
Taken hostage to Kasady's cathedral wedding, he survives Frances's scream, and his eyes flash with a piece of Carnage.
Believed dead, he is held at Area 51, where his new symbiote tells Strickland the Codex dies only if Eddie or Venom does.
He urges a captured Eddie to free the symbiote army, then is devoured when a Xenophage attacks the base.

files.notes: Only 'Mulligan'/'Detective Mulligan' is said in Let There Be Carnage; 'Detective Patrick Mulligan' is said on the news at the start of The Last Dance, so the name is staged. 'Toxin' is never said on screen (only trailer subtitles), so it is not used. Group SFPD: 'This is SFPD' is said on screen by the officers he commands; captivity at Area 51 is not service, so no Imperium stage. The Last Dance transcript is poor; his steps there rest on the Wikipedia and Marvel Movies wiki plots. Checked: the Wikipedia and Marvel Movies wiki plots of The Last Dance confirm he survived, was captured and bonded at Area 51, that his symbiote tells Strickland the Codex dies only if Eddie or Venom dies, and that a Xenophage devours him in the battle; his 'A symbiote army waits here. Free them' line is in the transcript.

st: Nova and her husband Martin take in hitchhiker Eddie and drive him to Las Vegas, then go on to Area 51 with their kids.
At Area 51 the family is caught in the battle with the Xenophages and gets out alive.

files.notes: Introduced by name by Martin ('this is my wife, Nova Moon'). The family belongs to no named group, so Independent. The transcript of the Area 51 battle is garbled; the second step only says the family is there and survives. Wikipedia's character article for Venom confirms the family is saved at Area 51 ('Eddie, Venom, and the symbiotes team up to save Moon and his family').

st: Echo jokes that hitchhiker Eddie is a serial killer as her family drives him to Las Vegas, then on to Area 51.

files.notes: Named by Martin ('my kids, Echo and Leaf'); the surname comes from her mother's introduction as Nova Moon. Independent: no group.

st: Leaf sneaks Eddie chocolate and admits he fears aliens, and at Area 51 Eddie reveals his best friend is one.

files.notes: Named by Martin ('my kids, Echo and Leaf') and called Leaf again at Area 51. Independent: no group. The transcript does not tag speakers; the chocolate and the fear of aliens are given to Leaf from context (the young son), and Venom greeting him at Area 51 rests on a garbled transcript line ('Pleasure to meet you... It's for the chocolate'). Wikipedia's character article for Venom confirms that at Area 51 Eddie, Venom and the symbiotes save Moon and his family; the film plots on Wikipedia and the Marvel Movies wiki give only the ride to Las Vegas on the family's way to Area 51, and neither mentions the chocolate or Venom greeting Leaf, which rest on the transcript.

st: Andre runs with the 110th Street Gang until Lonnie joins the gang in his place to free him.
Andre tells Lonnie that joining the gang to save him was the wrong call and that he can't hide it forever.

files.notes: Called Andre and Dre (transcripts, episodes 1, 3, 6). He joins the 110th willingly ('Dre came to us') and leaves when Lonnie takes his place in episode 3, so the gang stage ends there. In episode 7 Pearl says Dre told her about the gang, but that talk happens off screen.

k: The strict Oscorp scientist over the interns
st: Dr. Wittman takes charge of Oscorp's four new interns and berates Peter for wandering the secure building.
He tears apart Peter's battery pitch in front of the other interns.
He joins the Oscorp scientists briefing Norman on secret projects, among them a spider injected with Peter's blood.

files.notes: Introduces himself as Dr. Wittman and is called Bentley by Carla Connors (episode 2 transcript). Filed as A: a harsh boss, not a threat. The episode 9 step rests on the Wikipedia summary (no transcript for episodes 9 and 10); it does not say he works on the spider project himself. Checked against the Wikipedia episode 9 summary: Norman 'meets with several Oscorp scientists, including Wittman, who are working on various secret projects', one of them a spider injected with Peter's blood.

st: Carmilla Black, lieutenant of the Scorpions, corners Lonnie on her crew's turf and sends a threat to Big Donovan.
She fights beside Mac Gargan when the Scorpions try to take the 110th's turf.
She tails Lonnie to the 110th's hideout and reports its location to Gargan.

files.notes: Named by Big Donovan ('Her name's Carmilla Black. She's lieutenant for the local riffraff'), episode 4. Her lines and the turf fight rest on the transcripts, which tag her grunting in the episode 5 fight. Her part in the episode 7 attack and the episode 9 brawl is not confirmed by the transcripts, so no steps there. op is Lonnie, the hero she targets on screen; Spider-Man fights the Scorpions in episodes 7 and 9.

k: An enforcer in the 110th Street Gang
st: A 110th enforcer warns Big Donovan that the Scorpions are moving in on the 110th's turf.
Donovan sends him to pull Lonnie out of football practice for the turf war with the Scorpions.
He fights in the Scorpion attack on the 110th's hideout, then flees with the gang.

files.notes: Named in dialogue only as Bulldozer, first in episode 5 ('I sent Bulldozer to pick you up'; 'Dozer'), so the name is staged from #5 and his episode 4 scene calls him a 110th enforcer; Henry Camp is never said, so not used. He is also in episode 8, where he squares up to a gang member who mouths off at Donovan (no separate step). op is Mac Gargan: the Scorpions are the only side he fights on screen; Spider-Man rescues the gang in episode 7, and whether Bulldozer is at the episode 9 hijack is not confirmed (no transcript).

k: Peter's science teacher at Bales High
st: Mr. Taylor lets his class choose lab partners, and Lonnie asks to work with Peter.
With Lonnie missing class again, he pairs Peter with Pearl and Emma.

files.notes: Called Mr. Taylor by Lonnie (episode 1) and others; speaks in episodes 1 and 6 (transcripts). His school is the app's Rockford T. Bales High School ('Bales High' is said).

st: At a charity gala, Secretary Ross agrees to register Norman's Spider-Man under the Sokovia Accords and keep it quiet.
Tipped off by Norman, Ross arrests Otto Octavius for breaking the Accords, with Iron Man's help.

files.notes: A version of the MCU's Ross, so named Thaddeus Ross under the owner's rule; on screen he is Secretary Ross. His office is said, but no organization name is, so Independent. The arrest is in episode 8 in the transcripts (the app's Otto file dates it with his episode 9 prison scene). The 'call when the hero goes rogue' in the batch note was not found in episodes 1 to 8; episodes 9 and 10 have no transcript, so it is left out. The episode 8 date follows the transcript (and the Wikipedia episode 8 summary), not the app's Otto file.

st: Vincent disinfects Otto's lab after a sale and assures him they are close to showing the world his genius.
He calls to check on Otto and offers him soup, and Otto takes the agents at his door for Vincent.

files.notes: No saved wiki page; this rests on the transcripts, where Otto calls him Vincent (episodes 5 and 8). Patilio is never said, so not used. Octavius's operation has no group name on screen ('Octavius Tech' is a product), so Independent. He faces no hero himself; op is Norman Osborn, the man who hunts down the operation he serves (Norman tracks Otto and tips off Ross), and whose standing Otto and Vincent want to surpass. Status At large: he is not shown arrested with Otto.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Jack tells Eddie the network gave him a home and orders him to ask Carlton Drake only about his rocket. When Eddie accuses Drake on camera with no source, Jack fires him.
stages.whoA: The star reporter he fires
stages.whoB: Jack, the network boss who fires him

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Eddie greets Richard by name and cheers when he hears his daughter got into MIT on a scholarship. Later Richard refuses to let the fired Eddie upstairs, and Eddie stops Venom from eating him, saying Richard is his friend.
stages.whoA: The friend he has to turn away
stages.whoB: Richard, the guard Venom wants to eat

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Detective Mulligan pushes Eddie to visit Kasady, and Eddie later calls him with a lead from St. Estes. After Kasady escapes, Mulligan suspects Eddie, arrests him and grills him about the monsters.
stages.whoA: The reporter he uses, then suspects

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Eddie is blamed for Mulligan's apparent death. At Area 51 Eddie finds him alive with a new symbiote, which urges him to protect the Codex and free the captive symbiotes.
stages.whoA: The man wrongly blamed for his death
stages.whoB: Mulligan, alive at Area 51 with a symbiote

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: As a young officer, Mulligan shoots Frances in the eye and thinks she is dead. Years later she calls him the cop who took her eye, holds him hostage at the cathedral and blasts him with her scream.
stages.whoA: Frances, the screamer he once shot
stages.whoB: The cop who took her eye

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Mulligan hunts the escaped Kasady and the monster seen with him. Kasady takes him hostage as a wedding gift for Frances, and after the battle a piece of Carnage lives on in Mulligan.
stages.whoA: The killer who takes him hostage

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: When Venom bonds with Eddie again at Area 51, a Xenophage tracks the Codex to the base. In the battle it devours Mulligan.
stages.whoA: The hunters who kill him

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Martin introduces Nova as his wife, and they welcome hitchhiker Eddie into their camper. They drive him to Las Vegas, then take the family on to Area 51.
stages.whoA: Martin, her husband

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Nova and Martin take in the stranded Eddie and give him a ride to Las Vegas. At Area 51 her family is caught up in the battle he is fighting.
stages.whoA: The hitchhiker her family drives to Vegas
stages.whoB: Nova, who gives him a ride to Vegas

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Nova travels with her daughter Echo in the family camper. They drive Eddie to Las Vegas and go on to Area 51 together.
stages.whoA: Echo, her daughter

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Nova rides with her son Leaf in the camper as they drive Eddie to Las Vegas. The family then goes on to Area 51 together.
stages.whoA: Leaf, her son

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Martin introduces his daughter Echo to Eddie. She rides with her father to Las Vegas and on to the Area 51 he has always dreamed of seeing.
stages.whoA: Martin, her father

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Echo and her little brother Leaf ride in the back of the camper. They reach Area 51 together with their parents.
stages.whoA: Leaf, her little brother

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Echo greets hitchhiker Eddie by saying he must be a serial killer from her favorite murder podcast. She rides with him to Las Vegas in the family camper.
stages.whoA: The hitchhiker she teases

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Martin introduces his son Leaf to Eddie. Leaf rides with his father to Area 51 to look for aliens.
stages.whoA: Martin, his father

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: In the camper, Leaf slips Eddie chocolate and admits he is scared of aliens, and Eddie promises they are not real. At Area 51 Eddie admits he lied: his best friend is an alien who will get Leaf out.
stages.whoA: Eddie, the hitchhiker who looks after him
stages.whoB: Leaf, the boy who gives him chocolate

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Eddie takes Leaf's chocolate for a friend who loves it. At Area 51, Venom shows himself to Leaf and thanks him for the chocolate.
stages.whoA: The alien who thanks him
stages.whoB: The boy who gave him chocolate

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: When Andre is caught running with the 110th Street Gang, his brother Lonnie tracks his phone to their hideout and trades himself to Big Donovan to free him. Later Andre tells Lonnie the trade was the wrong call and he can't hide it forever.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, the brother who joins the gang for him

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Big Donovan claims Andre as the 110th's little brother and refuses to let him go. He releases Andre only when Lonnie offers himself instead.
stages.whoA: Big Donovan, the gang boss who claims him
stages.whoB: Dre, the kid he trades for Lonnie

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Wittman oversees Peter's internship at Oscorp and scolds him for being late and for leaving the lab. He later shreds Peter's battery pitch as a lesson to the other interns.
stages.whoA: Dr. Wittman, his harsh Oscorp supervisor

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Wittman hands Peter to Carla Connors for her energy project, and she warns Peter he treats science like a race. When Wittman rages that Peter is missing, Carla covers for him and tells Bentley to calm down.
stages.whoA: Carla Connors, the colleague who covers for Peter
stages.whoB: Bentley, the supervisor she keeps calm

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Wittman tests the four interns and mocks Amadeus for asking about robotics. He still places Amadeus in Oscorp's robotics division.
stages.whoA: Amadeus, the intern he puts in robotics
stages.whoB: Dr. Wittman, the supervisor who places him

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman saddles Wittman with four interns he never asked for. After Gargan's defeat, Wittman is among the scientists who meet Norman about Oscorp's secret projects.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, his employer

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Carmilla serves as Mac Gargan's lieutenant in the Scorpions and fights beside him in the turf war with the 110th. She tracks Lonnie to the 110th's hideout and tells Gargan the plan worked.
stages.whoA: Mac Gargan, her boss

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Carmilla corners Lonnie when he picks up food on Scorpion turf, and Big Donovan warns him she has seen his face. Later she tails him to the 110th's hideout.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, the 110th recruit she hunts
stages.whoB: Carmilla, the Scorpion who tails him

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Carmilla sends Big Donovan a threat through Lonnie, and Donovan calls her the Scorpions' lieutenant. She fights his gang when the Scorpions move on the 110th's turf.
stages.whoA: Big Donovan, the rival gang boss

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Bulldozer reports to Big Donovan that the Scorpions are moving in. Donovan sends him to fetch Lonnie for the turf war, and he fights beside the gang when the Scorpions attack.
stages.whoA: Big Donovan, his gang boss

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Bulldozer waits outside Lonnie's school to bring him to the turf war. At the hideout he calls Lonnie Tombstone and tells him Pearl has come to see him.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, the fellow gang member he calls Tombstone

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Bulldozer warns Donovan that Gargan's Scorpions are moving in on their turf. When Gargan attacks the hideout in his scorpion armor, Bulldozer fights and then runs.
stages.whoA: Gargan, the rival boss who attacks them

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Mr. Taylor lets Lonnie pick Peter as his lab partner, and the pair ace his first lab. When Lonnie stops coming to class, he puts Peter with Pearl and Emma.
stages.whoA: Mr. Taylor, his science teacher
stages.whoB: Parker, a student in his class

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Lonnie asks Mr. Taylor if he can work with Peter, and Mr. Taylor agrees. Lonnie later brags that they aced his first lab.
stages.whoA: Mr. Taylor, his science teacher
stages.whoB: Lincoln, the student who picks Peter

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: At a charity gala, Norman offers Oscorp's help with the Sokovia Accords and reveals Spider-Man as his asset, and Ross agrees to keep the registration quiet. Later Norman sends Ross Otto Octavius's location.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, the backer who tips him off

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Ross's agents corner Otto at his lab and charge him with violating the Sokovia Accords. When Otto tries to fight his way out, Iron Man arrives and Ross takes him in.
stages.whoA: Otto Octavius, the arms maker he arrests

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Iron Man flies in to stop Otto Octavius from escaping Ross's raid. Ross and Stark greet each other by name.
stages.whoA: Stark, who helps with the arrest
stages.whoB: Ross, whose raid he backs up

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Vincent cleans Otto's lab after a sale and soothes him that the world will soon revere him. Later he calls to check that Otto has eaten and offers soup, just before agents arrest Otto.
stages.whoA: Otto, the boss he looks after

dropped.why: Named on screen (Ms. O'Hara and Susan, episode 3; Susan, episode 7) and has lines, but no part in the plot: she calls Nico to the kitchen in episode 3 and answers the door to Harry in episode 7, and nothing that happens turns on her.

changes.now: [["A 110th enforcer", "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man"], ["Bulldozer", "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#5"]]
changes.why: His first scene (warning Donovan about the Scorpions) is in episode 4, but no one says 'Bulldozer' until episode 5 ('I sent Bulldozer to pick you up'), so the name is staged from #5.

changes.was: Bulldozer warns Big Donovan that the Scorpions are moving in on the 110th's turf.
changes.now: A 110th enforcer warns Big Donovan that the Scorpions are moving in on the 110th's turf.
changes.why: Names only once said: this event is in episode 4 and his name is first said in episode 5.

changes.now: Mac Gargan / [["sv-scorpion-yfnsm", "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man"], ["team:The Scorpions", "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man"]]
changes.why: On screen he never faces Spider-Man (who rescues the gang in episode 7); the people he fights are Mac Gargan and his Scorpions, in the turf war and the hideout attack.

Vincent never meets Spider-Man, and Spider-Man never faces Otto in these episodes. The one who moves against the operation Vincent serves is Norman, who hunts Otto and sends his location to Ross; Vincent backs Otto's wish to outshine Osborn ('You will be').

changes.was: file sv-susan-ohara-yfnsm and tie Susan O'Hara|Nico Minoru
changes.why: Named on screen (Ms. O'Hara and Susan, episode 3; Susan, episode 7) and has lines, but no part in the plot: she calls Nico to the kitchen in episode 3 and answers the door to Harry in episode 7, and nothing that happens turns on her.

changes.where: ties Bentley Wittman|Carla Connors stage 0 ep
changes.why: Every event the tie text describes (Wittman handing Peter to Carla, her remark that he treats science like a race, her covering for Peter and telling Bentley to calm down) is in episode 2.

changes.where: ties Mr. Taylor|Lonnie Lincoln stage 0 ep
changes.why: The last event in the text, Lonnie bragging that they aced Mr. Taylor's first lab, is in episode 3 ('I just found out from Mr. Taylor that we aced our first lab experiment').
